summary: M6-S2 is complete. Version 0.8 adds a tick-driven native panel task, observable bounded progress, honest between-batch cancellation, valid partial reports, baseline isolation, and deterministic Chinese HTML/CSV team handoff artifacts.
evidence: The native panel exposes pending, running, cancelling, completed, cancelled, and failed states with object and batch progress
One collection batch is advanced per Slate post-tick callback; cancellation is checked between batches and preserves completed work
Cancelled tasks write valid partial Reports and immutable sessions, while incomplete current sessions are excluded from regression baselines
Each Report can produce a standalone Chinese HTML report, UTF-8 BOM CSV, and a manifest containing SHA-256 hashes without rescanning assets
Every exported issue retains rule ID, localized description, observed value, expected value, Profile JSON Pointer, and Evidence ID
UE_5.8.1-v0.8.0-dev3 BuildPlugin completed UHT, C++ compilation, linking, and Win64 packaging
PanelEvidence and PanelTaskLifecycle passed in an independent hidden UE 5.8.1 process without terminating the pre-existing user Unreal process
Real host evidence preserves 19 complete and cancelled task artifacts with hashes, including Reports, sessions, task states, HTML, CSV, and manifests
Fourteen current production Slate screenshots plus one independently reviewed standalone HTML screenshot document the workflow
unresolvedRisks: Visible mouse-click, docking, and cancellation timing remain manual recording evidence
A single C++ collection batch is still synchronous and the plugin does not claim that large production projects never stall
Only UE 5.8.1 is currently supported by recorded host evidence
A clean end-user release archive and fresh-project installation proof remain for M7
No asset mutation, automatic repair, AI, or PCG capability is authorized
